page.notes: The Greek words "προτρεπτικὴ" and "προτροπῆς" are blurred in the scan and are read provisionally. The word after "fume-" at the line end is uncertain; it is read as "sumus". "defiderare", "often" and "defit" are copied as printed. The first word of the line after "Trebatio" reads "officium often", probably a printing error for "often" but left as printed. The marginal note is set in italic type.
